label: Search economy code retrieval Q1 enriched single shot and Q2 agentic DAG arm results evidence chunk 1
title: Search economy code retrieval Q1 enriched single shot and Q2 agentic DAG arm results evidence chunk 1
summary: Measured the enriched code_node embed fix (source body folded into the code_node embed surface) on the 13-query search-economy code-retrieval corpus, using the Zonoid Bench SDK isolated daemon (free port, never :8787) spawned from the enriched worktree, onboarding lib/+routes/ (1174 code_nodes, lib:1110 routes:64) via scripts/onboard-code path. Metric per query: LOCATE -> FETCH top-6 located symbols real source via code_node.file[start..end] -> 12k-char bundle -> recall = |relevant ∩ identifier-tokens| / |relevant| (case-insensitive whole-token); tokens=ceil(chars/4).
